findings: Engine framebuffer before CEF capture visibly contains the full caption and full import notice.
PrintWindow from the same view contains the scene but loses almost all UI panels and text.
CEF surface visibly contains the full caption and import notice, without the native scene.
Engine framebuffer PNGs before and after CEF capture are identical bytes; the capture did not change the native image in this comparison.
The cyan spherical outline with spatial=false belongs to the magnetic reference_grid, constructed by body_field_scene.prepare and controlled with magnetic nodes; it is distinct from the spatial wire.
This comparison establishes a capture-method discrepancy; it does not establish the internal Windows/CEF cause or retroactively accept earlier incomplete PrintWindow images.
scope: Manual diagnostic image comparison only; not the K5 visual cut, performance or product acceptance.
